incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detected GPU pool 'hotpath-prod' high saturation. queue_depth=~2700, 429_rate rising for tier=prod-high. AlertID=INC-1993210000

sam: ack. taking first responder. paging @maria @jason.

maria: seeing lots of `rate_limiter.reject` for tier=prod-high: `reason=token_exhausted tokens=0`. Token refill looks off.

jason: autoscaler attempted scale to target=12 but stuck at 6. Allocator logs: `scale_request denied: pool_quota_exceeded`. There's an account-level limit on G4 pools.

ashley: tl;dr: pool capacity exhausted + token bucket config mismatch + autoscaler blocked by quota. Customers on prod-high are seeing 429s. Need immediate mitigation and comms plan.

sam: options: (A) bump token bucket for prod-high feature-flagged, (B) enable overflow to prod-medium, (C) request emergency cloud quota bump. Which to do now?

maria: do A and B in parallel. A is fastest. I'll apply a temporary token rate increase and watch.

maria: running command: `redwoodctl config set rate.tiers.prod-high.token_rate 2400 --env=prod`

incident-bot: config rc-875 applied, rolling to proxies.

jason: enabling overflow route patch to allow prod-medium accept overflow from prod-high for models=*

```
PATCH /routing/policies/overflow
{ "from_tier": "prod-high", "to_tier": "prod-medium", "enabled": true }
```

sam: overflow enabled. monitoring metrics now.

sam: queue depth falling: 2700 -> 820 in ~2m. 429 on prod-high dropped from ~30% -> 7%. trending good.

kevin: draft customer note: "We experienced elevated 429s due to GPU pool saturation between 17:55-18:05 UTC. Mitigations applied, traffic recovering. RCA to follow." Should we wait before sending?

ashley: wait 10m and confirm 5m steady before external comms. also start internal incident doc.

maria: found bug: older config used ms units incorrectly in token window causing slower refill. filing PR to correct units and add test coverage.

jason: pushed temporary autoscaler policy to request ephemeral burst nodes for 20m: patch id=burst-ephemeral-1993. Allocator accepted 2 ephemeral nodes. pool_capacity now 8/12 (transient).

incident-bot: Autoscaler event: ephemeral nodes allocated.

sam: with token bump + overflow + ephem nodes, p99 latency improved 1.7s -> 0.95s and overall 429s down to ~1.5%. Holding for 30m monitoring.

maria: long-term changes proposed: validate token unit fields on config load, add defensive defaults for token windows, and ensure autoscaler fallback to lower-tier pools when quota errors repeat.

ashley: action list: ops: open cloud emergency quota ticket (#CLOUD-9002) - sam; runtime: config unit fix + tests - maria; infra: default overflow/fallback policy for quota-limited pools - jason; support: prepare customer comms post-stabilization - kevin.

sam: CLOUD-9002 filed and linked here. awaiting cloud response.

kevin: notifying top affected customers privately (cust-842, cust-119, cust-271) with status update template.

sam: metrics steady for 12m. planning to de-escalate P1->P2 if stable for 30m. last_message_ts=1993213800

ashley: good work. schedule 48h postmortem, include timeline, config diffs (rc-872 -> rc-875), token refill traces, and autoscaler quota behavior. assign owners.

maria: filing PR: https://git.internal/redwood/configs/pull/1423 with unit fix.

jason: follow-up improvement: if allocator returns repeated `quota_exceeded` for >3 attempts within 2m, autoscaler should immediately enable overflow routing for that pool. filing RFC.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1993210000: Mitigated -> Recovering. Follow-ups filed. :white_check_mark:
